description: The portion census the Network Monitor writes in answer to the census form of node_query (architecture §3.12.3, implementation §10.1): one row per node the Spawner provisioned on the network, with the fields of the Active Node Registry (architecture §3.11, implementation §1.2.14), and no signal.

nodes.description: The fleet: a running node and one whose container is stopped alike, because both are deployed (architecture §3.12.3).

artifact_ref.description: The digest of the image its Logic Container runs (architecture §3.13.3).

topic.description: The topic of the niche it covers (architecture §3.11).

model_id.description: That of its credential: the vector space it was signed under (architecture §3.12.3).

signer_id.description: The key its credential was signed with (architecture §3.11).

egress_grants.description: The egress_registry entries it reaches, each with its slot and the interface's digest (architecture §3.16.3).

ingress_grants.description: In a channel, the ingress_registry entries it receives through (architecture §3.16.7).

memory_required.description: The memory reservation of its Logic Container, in MB, which is the entry's effective reservation it was brought up with (architecture §3.13.10).
